      private List<MainBodyM.Employee> fetchEmployees() throws SQLException

    • insertEmployee

      private void insertEmployee(String name, BigDecimal payLevel, String contactInfo) throws SQLException
      Inserts an employee using one more than the current maximum employee ID. The insert runs in a transaction that is rolled back on an SQL failure.
      Parameters:
      name - employee name
      payLevel - employee pay amount
      contactInfo - employee contact information
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the connection, ID lookup, insert, or transaction fails

    • updateEmployee

      private void updateEmployee(int id, String name, BigDecimal payLevel, String contactInfo) throws SQLException
      Updates an existing employee's name, pay, and contact information.
      Parameters:
      id - employee ID to update
      name - replacement employee name
      payLevel - replacement pay amount
      contactInfo - replacement contact information
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database operation fails or the employee no longer exists

      private void deleteEmployee(int id) throws SQLException
